thread:
Asha (CS): quick capture from Sprintly onboarding. multiple asks surfaced during ramp; renewal touchpoint in ~6 weeks. capturing here for triage + enablement.

Asha (CS): items pulled from onboarding notes: 
1) Per-route embedding TTL control — they want dev routes to have shorter TTLs to avoid accumulation.
2) Finance wants a CSV export of per-route token & cost breakdown (monthly) for their internal audits.
3) Onboarding flow missing an explicit KMS/service-account hookup step — customers get stuck before go-live.
4) Console alerting for reserved capacity thresholds (e.g., warn at 80%) — they missed a usage surge last week.

Priya (PM): can we add impact notes? renewal in ~6w so prioritization matters.

Asha (CS): quick impact: 1) TTL toggle = medium (cost control for dev/test). 2) CSV export = high (finance dependency for renewal). 3) KMS hookup = high (blocks deployment). 4) capacity alert = medium-high (ops risk). Customer said KMS workstream will determine renewal timeline.

Diego (Eng): feasibility quick take: TTL toggle is small (per-route flag + config). CSV export is small-to-medium (usage aggregation + CSV endpoint/UI). KMS UX touches docs + console wiring + security review  needs coordination. Capacity alert is small.

Priya (PM): proposed triage: P0 = KMS onboarding UX + docs; P1 = CSV cost export; P2 = TTL toggle; P2 = capacity alert (can ship as a simple threshold notification first). Agree?

Matt (SE): immediate workarounds: for CSV, run a manual export via API and share script. Example snippet:

```
# pseudo: manual per-route cost export
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage?account=sprintly&granularity=route&start=2025-02-01&end=2025-02-28" \
  | jq '.routes[] | {route, tokens, cost}' > sprintly-feb-route-costs.csv
```

Matt (SE): for KMS onboarding we can do a live assist. Ana?

Ana (Enablement): I can run a hands-on onboarding session tomorrow 10:30 PT. I'll prepare a one-page checklist that maps console steps to the KMS/service-account ops and circulate a copy. Can the checklist be added to the onboarding modal as interim text (copy/paste)?

Priya (PM): yes. I'll open a short spike ticket for KMS console changes + security signoff. Diego, can you take a 2d spike to enumerate infra & vault/KMS changes?

Diego (Eng): I'll pick up the spike Monday and post findings here.

Asha (CS): customer update plan: tell Sprintly we will 1) run an immediate enablement call, 2) provide the manual CSV script as a temporary workaround, and 3) prioritize a KMS UX spike. They replied :relieved: and will wait for the follow-up before confirming renewal.
